products.name: Workday AI
products.note: HR and finance AI; skills-based talent; predictive analytics; sensitive HR data exposure

profile_text.body:
Workday is a public enterprise software company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. According to its website, the company describes itself as an Enterprise AI Platform for HR, Finance, and IT, offering what it calls "a new way to work with Sana and agentic AI from Workday." The company positions its AI capability around activating teams of specialized agents to perform key processes across HR, finance, and IT, stating that its agents can "find, build, act, and automate in ways that support and empower your people."

Workday's primary AI product is Workday AI, categorized as HR and finance AI with capabilities in skills-based talent matching and predictive analytics. The company's recent annual revenue for the period ending January 31, 2026 was $9,552,000,000, according to its 10-K filing. The company trades on the public markets under ticker WDAY and has a CIK of 0001327811.

The company faces significant legal exposure, with nine cases tracked across multiple district courts including the Eastern District of California, Northern District of Georgia, Northern District of California, District of Colorado, District of Maryland, and Eastern District of Virginia. California accounts for 220 cases in the system, reflecting substantial litigation activity in the state.
